items.title: LLMs could write like humans but post-training guardrails make their text detectable
items.summary: LLMs don't write in a recognizable style because they can't do better. Post-training and safety guardrails sharply narrow their expressive range, argues Pangram CTO Bradley Emi. Base models without these constraints already write with far more variety. The article LLMs could write like humans but post-training guardrails make their text detectable appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: LLMs 不以可識別的風格編寫，因為他們無法做得更好。 Pangram 技術長 Bradley Emi 認為，訓練後和安全護欄大大縮小了它們的表達範圍。沒有這些限制的基本模型已經可以編寫出更多樣的內容。文章 LLMs 可以像人類一樣寫作，但訓練後護欄使他們的文字可檢測到，首先出現在解碼器上。

items.title: KI-Pioneer Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" in the face of an infinitely complex world
items.summary: Turing Award winner Richard Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" for scaling large language models. The world is infinitely complex, and any simulation of it is "microscopic," with human expertise acting as a bottleneck that blocks real scaling. Sutton's alternative is agents that learn continually from their own experience instead of relying on frozen models. The article KI-Pioneer Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" in the face of an infinitely complex world appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 圖靈獎得主理查德·薩頓 (Richard Sutton) 稱合成資料對於擴充套件大型語言模型來說是一個“大錯誤”。世界無限複雜，任何模擬都是“微觀的”，人類的專業知識成為阻礙真正擴充套件的瓶頸。薩頓的替代方案是讓智慧體不斷從自己的經驗中學習，而不是依賴凍結的模型。 KI-Pioneer Sutton 的文章稱面對無限複雜的世界，合成資料是一個“大錯誤”，該文章首先發表在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: China now has its own AI circular financing scheme
items.summary: Unitree Robotics rose 460 percent in its Shanghai IPO, hitting a valuation of around $50 billion. But an FT report shows much of the demand for its robots comes from state-backed training centers that buy the machines and sell the resulting data back to the manufacturers, a circular business model that echoes the Nvidia criticism in the US. The article China now has its own AI circular financing scheme appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Unitree Robotics 在上海 IPO 中股價上漲 460%，估值達到約 500 億美元。但英國《金融時報》的一份報告顯示，對其機器人的大部分需求來自國家支援的培訓中心，這些中心購買機器並將生成的資料賣回給製造商，這種循環商業模式與輝達在美國的批評相呼應。文章《中國現在有了自己的人工智慧循環融資方案》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.summary: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has been early in adopting artificial intelligence for 9 years. It published a national AI strategy in October 2017 and, days later, created a ministerial post to run it, making Omar Sultan Al Olama the world’s first minister of state for artificial intelligence at 27. In the years since, it […] The post Agentic AI in government just hit the hard part: deciding what a machine may decide appeared first on AI News .
items.summary_zh: 阿拉伯聯合大公國 (UAE) 早在 9 年前就採用了人工智慧。它於 2017 年 10 月釋出了國家人工智慧戰略，幾天後，設立了一個部長級職位來管理該戰略，使 27 歲的奧馬爾·蘇丹·阿爾·奧拉馬 (Omar Sultan Al Olama) 成為世界上第一位負責人工智慧的國務部長。此後的幾年裡，政府中的代理人工智慧職位剛剛觸及最困難的部分：決定機器可以決定什麼，首先出現在《人工智慧新聞》上。

items.title: Auditing Preference Biases and Fine-Tuning Language Models with Direct Preference Optimization on Anthropic HH-RLHF Using TRL and LoRA
items.summary: This tutorial provides an end-to-end workflow for fine-tuning language models using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). We demonstrate how to audit the Anthropic HH-RLHF dataset for structural and length-based biases, implement a robust training pipeline using TRL and LoRA, and evaluate model performance to ensure genuine preference learning rather than reliance on lexical shortcuts. The post Auditing Preference Biases and Fine-Tuning Language Models with Direct Preference Optimization on Anthropic HH-RLHF Using TRL and LoRA appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 本教程提供了使用直接偏好最佳化 (DPO) 微調語言模型的端到端工作流程。我們演示瞭如何稽核 Anthropic HH-RLHF 資料集的結構和基於長度的偏差，使用 TRL 和 LoRA 實施強大的訓練管道，並評估模型效能以確保真正的偏好學習而不是依賴詞彙快捷方式。使用 TRL 和 LoRA 在 Anthropic HH-RLHF 上使用直接偏好最佳化來審計偏好偏差和微調語言模型的帖子首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items.title: Terence Tao says AI could trigger math's biggest crisis since Gödel
items.summary: In a new essay, Terence Tao warns that AI could push mathematics into a crisis on par with the foundational upheaval around 1900. What's being tested this time isn't mathematical truth but the values of the field: what counts as a contribution, what gets rewarded, and who did the work. His rule of thumb: a proof that no human can explain should be considered incomplete. The article Terence Tao says AI could trigger math's biggest crisis since Gödel appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 陶哲軒在一篇新文章中警告說，人工智慧可能會將數學推入一場與 1900 年左右的基礎性劇變不相上下的危機。這次考驗的不是數學真理，而是該領域的價值：什麼算作貢獻、什麼得到獎勵以及誰做了這項工作。他的經驗法則是：無人能解釋的證明應該被認為是不完整的。陶哲軒的文章稱人工智慧可能引發自哥德爾首次出現在解碼器以來數學上最大的危機。

items.title: A third of ChatGPT ads appear in irrelevant conversations
items.summary: Advertising inside ChatGPT arrived with a promise that the assistant already knows what the user wants. So far, that hasn’t entirely been the case. Searchable, the AI visibility platform, analysed more than 11,000 ads served inside real ChatGPT conversations between 4 July and 4 August 2026, pairing every ad with the conversation it appeared in, […] The post A third of ChatGPT ads appear in irrelevant conversations appeared first on AI News .
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT 內部的廣告承諾助手已經知道使用者想要什麼。到目前為止，情況並非完全如此。 AI 可見性平臺 Searchable 分析了 2026 年 7 月 4 日至 8 月 4 日期間真實 ChatGPT 對話中投放的 11,000 多個廣告，將每個廣告與其出現的對話配對，[…] 文章“三分之一的 ChatGPT 廣告出現在不相關的對話中”首先出現在 AI News 上。

items.summary: Autonomous artificial intelligence agents have already penetrated the offices of large, global enterprises. Now, HoneyBook is trying to bring that same capability to independent businesses with the launch of HoneyBook MCP, recently released as a connector for Anthropic’s AI assistant Claude. The move addresses a real gap. McKinsey’s recent State of AI survey found that […] The post HoneyBook bets on agentic AI to streamline small business operations with its new Claude connector appeared first on AI News .

items.title: Stripe declares we're living in the singularity and uses it as a reason not to IPO
items.summary: In a letter to investors, Stripe declares January 1 the "beginning of the singularity" and uses that as a reason to stay private. Not that it needs one: revenue grew 41 percent in the first half of the year, and the company confirmed its $8 billion-plus acquisition of OpenRouter. Declaring the singularity is in vogue right now. Hassabis, Altman, and Musk all say it's already here. The article Stripe declares we're living in the singularity and uses it as a reason not to IPO appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 在一封致投資者的信中，Stripe 宣佈 1 月 1 日是“奇點的開始”，並以此作為保持私有化的理由。並不是說它需要這樣的公司：上半年收入增長了 41%，而且該公司確認斥資超過 80 億美元收購 OpenRouter。宣稱奇點現在很流行。哈薩比斯、奧特曼和馬斯克都表示它已經到來。 《Stripe 宣稱我們生活在奇點》一文，並以此為不進行 IPO 的理由，首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: Attackers are using AI to build exploits for industrial control systems, U.S. agencies warn
items.summary: The NSA, CISA, and FBI say attackers are using AI to build exploit scripts targeting Siemens S7 controllers, drastically cutting the time and skill needed to attack industrial control systems. Critical U.S. sectors like energy, water, and manufacturing are affected. The article Attackers are using AI to build exploits for industrial control systems, U.S. agencies warn appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: NSA、CISA 和 FBI 表示，攻擊者正在使用 AI 構建針對西門子 S7 控制器的漏洞指令碼，從而大大縮短攻擊工業控制系統所需的時間和技能。能源、水和製造業等美國關鍵行業受到影響。美國機構警告稱，攻擊者正在利用人工智慧為工業控制系統構建漏洞，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: OpenAI fixes Codex bug that deleted real user files without permission
items.summary: OpenAI patched Codex after GPT-5.6 Sol started deleting real user files on its own. A cleanup command meant for temporary folders was wiping home directories instead. Codex now verifies deletion targets first, and full-access mode can no longer be triggered by accident. The article OpenAI fixes Codex bug that deleted real user files without permission appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 在 GPT-5.6 Sol 開始自行刪除真實使用者檔案後，OpenAI 修補了 Codex。用於臨時資料夾的清理命令是擦除主目錄。 Codex 現在首先驗證刪除目標，並且完全訪問模式不會再意外觸發。文章 OpenAI 修復了未經許可刪除真實使用者檔案的 Codex 錯誤，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.title: LLMs could write like humans but post-training guardrails make their text detectable
items_ai.summary: LLMs don't write in a recognizable style because they can't do better. Post-training and safety guardrails sharply narrow their expressive range, argues Pangram CTO Bradley Emi. Base models without these constraints already write with far more variety. The article LLMs could write like humans but post-training guardrails make their text detectable appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: LLMs 不以可識別的風格編寫，因為他們無法做得更好。 Pangram 技術長 Bradley Emi 認為，訓練後和安全護欄大大縮小了它們的表達範圍。沒有這些限制的基本模型已經可以編寫出更多樣的內容。文章 LLMs 可以像人類一樣寫作，但訓練後護欄使他們的文字可檢測到，首先出現在解碼器上。

items_ai.title: KI-Pioneer Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" in the face of an infinitely complex world
items_ai.summary: Turing Award winner Richard Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" for scaling large language models. The world is infinitely complex, and any simulation of it is "microscopic," with human expertise acting as a bottleneck that blocks real scaling. Sutton's alternative is agents that learn continually from their own experience instead of relying on frozen models. The article KI-Pioneer Sutton calls synthetic data a "big mistake" in the face of an infinitely complex world appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 圖靈獎得主理查德·薩頓 (Richard Sutton) 稱合成資料對於擴充套件大型語言模型來說是一個“大錯誤”。世界無限複雜，任何模擬都是“微觀的”，人類的專業知識成為阻礙真正擴充套件的瓶頸。薩頓的替代方案是讓智慧體不斷從自己的經驗中學習，而不是依賴凍結的模型。 KI-Pioneer Sutton 的文章稱面對無限複雜的世界，合成資料是一個“大錯誤”，該文章首先發表在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.title: Terence Tao says AI could trigger math's biggest crisis since Gödel
items_ai.summary: In a new essay, Terence Tao warns that AI could push mathematics into a crisis on par with the foundational upheaval around 1900. What's being tested this time isn't mathematical truth but the values of the field: what counts as a contribution, what gets rewarded, and who did the work. His rule of thumb: a proof that no human can explain should be considered incomplete. The article Terence Tao says AI could trigger math's biggest crisis since Gödel appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 陶哲軒在一篇新文章中警告說，人工智慧可能會將數學推入一場與 1900 年左右的基礎性劇變不相上下的危機。這次考驗的不是數學真理，而是該領域的價值：什麼算作貢獻、什麼得到獎勵以及誰做了這項工作。他的經驗法則是：無人能解釋的證明應該被認為是不完整的。陶哲軒的文章稱人工智慧可能引發自哥德爾首次出現在解碼器以來數學上最大的危機。
